summary: Neo and Agent Smith engage in a high-speed gunfight in a subway station, moving at impossible speeds until they are nearly on top of each other, jamming their guns to each other's heads. Both fire empty chambers. Agent Smith, initially machine-calm, becomes enraged and attacks Neo with fists, wounding his forearm and slamming him into a steel column. Neo recovers, snaps Agent Smith's neck with a reverse round-house, causing Smith's glasses to fly off. Smith, with ice blue eyes, declares he will enjoy watching Neo die and resumes pounding him with unrelenting fury.
